functions.name: find_destination_agents
functions.title: Find and notify destination agents
functions.description: Finds the top 5 real estate agents in a destination city via web search, creates referral proposal records, and emails each agent an exclusive relocation lead offer with accept/decline links. Admin only. Use when a seller is relocating and you need to recruit receiving-market agents.

seller_outreach_id.description: The ListingOwner/SellerOutreach record id this lead came from.

destination_city.description: City the seller is moving to.

destination_state.description: State the seller is moving to (2-letter, e.g. TX).

seller_name.description: Seller's full name for the email.

functions.name: create_owner_outreach_campaign
functions.title: Create owner outreach campaign
functions.description: Creates an OwnerOutreachCampaign record for a listing owner if one does not already exist. Admin only. Use before sending the first outreach SMS to a homeowner.

listing_owner_id.description: The ListingOwner record id to start a campaign for.

functions.name: send_owner_sms_batch
functions.title: Send owner outreach SMS batch
functions.description: Sends the Day 1 owner-outreach SMS to a batch of listing owners via Twilio, using the 'Owner Outreach SMS #1 - Day 1' template. Admin only. Each owner needs a valid phone and listing_owner_id. Logs the batch to BatchSMSLog.

city.description: City label for the batch log.

owner_name.description: Owner name for the template merge.

functions.name: run_morning_broadcast
functions.title: Run DNN morning broadcast
functions.description: Drives the DNN morning broadcast pipeline. action 'generate' writes today's Charlie/Bob scripts from published articles; 'render' starts HeyGen clip renders; 'run' does both; 'check' polls in-progress renders and stores completed videos. Admin only.

action.description: One of: generate, render, run, check.

functions.name: generate_daily_articles
functions.title: Generate daily DNN articles
functions.description: Generates 10 localized DNN Intelligence Briefs across random markets and trigger types (tax, housing, jobs, rates, migration, employer news) and publishes them to the consumer feed. No parameters. Admin only.

functions.name: trigger_broadcast_distribution
functions.title: Trigger broadcast distribution
functions.description: Fires the n8n multi-channel publishing webhook for a broadcast whose status is 'ready' and has a videoUrl, publishing to LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, SMS, and email. Pass the broadcast id. Admin only.

entity_id.description: The DnnBroadcast record id to distribute.

functions.name: render_article_video
functions.title: Render article avatar video
functions.description: Synthesizes anchor audio for a DNN article and kicks off a HeyGen lip-sync avatar video render. Returns a video_id to poll via heygenCheckVideo. Admin only.

article_id.description: The DnnArticle record id to render.

avatar_id.description: HeyGen Photo Avatar id. Defaults to 'Adrian_public_2_20240312' if omitted.

functions.name: generate_referral_agreement
functions.title: Generate referral agreement
functions.description: Generates a Relocation Referral & Management Agreement document (markdown text) between Dyson & Dyson and a listing agent/broker for a specific property. Returns the agreement text ready for signature.

referral_fee_percent.description: Referral fee percent of D&D's management fee. Defaults to 25.

relocation_mgmt_fee_percent.description: Relocation management fee percent of buyer-side commission. Defaults to 15.

functions.name: run_higgsfield_daily_show
functions.title: Run Higgsfield daily show
functions.description: Triggers the daily DNN news show generation using the Higgsfield + 11 Labs pipeline. Gathers today's published article headlines, creates a DnnBroadcast record, and fires the n8n webhook to render the full show (Gemini script, Higgsfield video, 11 Labs audio, stitched MP4). No parameters — runs automatically on schedule but can be triggered manually. Admin only.

functions.name: start_daily_video_pipeline
functions.title: Start daily video pipeline
functions.description: Creates a DnnBroadcast record and fires the n8n webhook to start the Higgsfield + 11 Labs render pipeline. Optionally pass prompt_topics to override the default (today's published article headlines). n8n generates the script, renders the video, generates audio, stitches 3 scenes into one MP4, and calls back with the result. Admin only.

prompt_topics.description: Optional topics/headlines override. If omitted, uses today's published article headlines.

functions.name: rerun_broadcast
functions.title: Rerun a botched broadcast
functions.description: Re-dispatches an existing DnnBroadcast through the n8n Higgsfield + 11 Labs pipeline. Use this when a show's stitched video has scenes in the wrong order or the render came out wrong. Resets the broadcast to 'processing', clears stale video state, and re-fires the n8n webhook with explicit intro-content-outro scene ordering. Admin only.

broadcast_id.description: The DnnBroadcast record id to re-render.

functions.name: distribute_broadcast_to_audience
functions.title: Distribute broadcast to B2B audience
functions.description: Sends a finished DNN broadcast to a B2B audience (e.g. Corporate HR Managers) via Gmail. Fetches all active AudienceContact records for the given audience_id and sends a personalized email to each. Skips bounced/unsubscribed contacts. Records each send in the broadcast's distribution array. Admin only.

broadcast_id.description: The DnnBroadcast record id to distribute.

audience_id.description: The TargetAudienceProfile record id to send to.

subject.description: Optional email subject line. Defaults to 'DNN Intelligence — Show N: headlines'.

preheader.description: Optional preview text shown before the email body.

mode.description: Set to 'first_touch' to send only to contacts who haven't received anything yet, using the audience's first-touch template. Omit for standard distribution.

functions.name: blast_facebook
functions.title: Blast latest article to Facebook
functions.description: Posts the most recent published DNN article with a completed video to the Dyson Facebook Page. Builds social copy from the article headline and teaser, posts to Facebook, and marks the article as 'blasted' on success. No parameters. Admin only.

functions.name: post_to_linkedin
functions.title: Post video or image to LinkedIn
functions.description: Posts a video (or image fallback) to LinkedIn. When videoUrl is provided, uploads and posts the video; otherwise falls back to imageUrl. When organizationName is provided, posts to that company page (must be an admin); otherwise posts to the user's personal profile. Admin only.

videoUrl.description: URL of the video to upload and post. Required if no imageUrl.

imageUrl.description: URL of the image to post (fallback when no video). Required if no videoUrl.

title.description: Optional title for the media attachment.

description.description: Optional alt text / description for the media.

organizationName.description: Optional LinkedIn organization page name to post as. If omitted, posts to the user's personal profile.

functions.name: vet_agent
functions.title: Vet a real estate agent
functions.description: Runs an AI-powered vetting analysis on a real estate agent candidate for the DNN Agent Bureau. Scores DRE license status, production volume, market specialization, brokerage reputation, buyer-side experience, communication fit, and referral protectability. Returns a full vetting report with score (out of 35), recommendation (APPROVE/CONDITIONAL/REJECT), summary, red flags, and interview questions. Admin only.

dre_number.description: DRE license number (optional but flagged if missing).

state.description: State that issued the license, e.g. CA. Defaults to CA.

brokerage.description: Brokerage name (optional but flagged if missing).

functions.name: vet_lender
functions.title: Vet a mortgage lender
functions.description: Runs an AI-powered vetting analysis on a mortgage lender candidate for the DNN Vetted Lender Bureau. Scores NMLS license status, production volume, loan type expertise, close-time performance, communication reputation, company backing, and fiduciary fit. Returns a full vetting report with score (out of 35), recommendation, summary, red flags, and interview questions. Admin only.

nmls_number.description: NMLS license number (optional but flagged if missing).

loan_types.description: Loan types offered (comma-separated, e.g. 'conventional, FHA, VA, jumbo, bridge, DSCR').

functions.name: send_client_sms
functions.title: Send SMS to a client
functions.description: Sends a single SMS message to a client via Twilio. Use for individual, personalized messages (not batch blasts). Requires a valid E.164 phone number and message body. Admin only.

client_id.description: Optional RelocationClient record id for logging.

functions.name: subscribe_to_dnn
functions.title: Subscribe a user to DNN
functions.description: Subscribes an email address to the DNN daily news broadcast. Creates a DnnSubscriber record (tier 1 / free) or re-subscribes if they previously unsubscribed. Optionally tag them to a partner agent's silo. No auth required — can be called from public-facing subscribe forms.

partner_agent_id.description: Optional PartnerAgent id to tag this subscriber to an agent's silo.

partner_agent_name.description: Optional denormalized agent name for display.

functions.name: notify_admin_sms
functions.title: Send admin alert SMS
functions.description: Sends an SMS alert to the admin phone number (configured via ADMIN_PHONE_NUMBER secret). Use to notify the team of important events — new client messages, inbound communications, or custom alerts. Accepts a freeform payload; if 'message' is provided it sends that text directly, otherwise it builds an alert from event/data fields. No auth required — typically called by automations.

message.description: Custom alert text to send. If provided, sent directly. Otherwise the function builds an alert from event/data fields.

event.description: Optional event payload (entity_name, type) for structured alerts.

data.description: Optional entity data payload for structured alerts.

functions.name: notify_escalation_email
functions.title: Email admins about a Charlie escalation
functions.description: Emails all admin users when Charlie (the AI concierge) couldn't answer a consumer question and a human response is needed. Includes the consumer's name, email, question, the page they were on, priority level, and Charlie's handoff line. Typically called by an entity automation when a CharlieEscalation record is created. No auth required.

handoff_response.description: The handoff line Charlie used when deflecting.

priority.description: Priority level: low, medium, high, or urgent. Defaults to medium.

page_context.description: Which page the consumer was on when they asked.

functions.name: stitch_broadcast_clips
functions.title: Stitch broadcast clips into one video
functions.description: Stitches individual broadcast clips into a single composited MP4 using HeyGen multi-input rendering. action 'start' finds a completed broadcast with clips but no composited video and starts the stitch render; 'check' polls in-progress stitching renders and stores completed videos. Admin only.

broadcastId.description: Optional DnnBroadcast record id to stitch. If omitted with action 'start', uses the most recent completed broadcast with un-stitched clips.
